summary: 10 concrete, comment-endorsed products surfaced from a complete HN front-page crawl.
telegram_footer: 10 items surfaced | 30/30 current front-page stories processed | history + run artifact updated.

items.name: stravacli
items.source_story_title: A physicist rigged his pet hamster’s wheel to upload to Strava
items.summary: A command-line client for uploading activities to Strava without a premium account.
items.why_included: Its author suggested it as a way to avoid the premium auto-upload requirement.
items.evidence: The author points to stravacli as a possible cheaper alternative for automated Strava uploads.

evidence_sources.author: dlenski
evidence_sources.excerpt: He might be able to use https://github.com/dlenski/stravacli

items.name: It's Quieter in the Twilight
items.source_story_title: NASA figured out how to keep its Voyager 2 probe running for another year
items.summary: A 2022 documentary about the people keeping NASA's Voyager mission alive.
items.why_included: A commenter directly recommended it as a beautiful documentary.
items.evidence: The recommendation is explicit and enthusiastic.

evidence_sources.author: bcraven
evidence_sources.excerpt: Ah, good, an opportunity to recommend It's Quieter in the Twilight (2022). Beautiful documentary.

items.name: Zoom Earth
items.source_story_title: DeepMind's WeatherNext model achieves breakthrough forecasting cyclones
items.summary: A weather and storm-tracking app with detailed tropical-cyclone forecasts.
items.why_included: A newly discovered user calls its iPhone app terrific for cyclone tracking.
items.evidence: A first-hand user specifically praised the app while sharing its storm forecasts.

evidence_sources.author: jen729w
evidence_sources.excerpt: I get mine via https://zoom.earth (whose iPhone app is terrific).

items.name: Tropical Tidbits
items.source_story_title: DeepMind's WeatherNext model achieves breakthrough forecasting cyclones
items.summary: A weather-analysis site for raw forecast-model data and run comparisons.
items.why_included: A weather follower named it their go-to source for raw model data.
items.evidence: The commenter recommends it for comparing individual model runs against forecast guidance.

items.name: WindNinja
items.source_story_title: DeepMind's WeatherNext model achieves breakthrough forecasting cyclones
items.summary: A National Forest Service tool for modelling near-surface winds over complex terrain.
items.why_included: It was recommended as an option when terrain-driven local wind error matters.
items.evidence: A commenter identifies it as a good US option for detailed wind conditions.

evidence_sources.author: micro2588
evidence_sources.excerpt: These are all good options for the US and if the one main source of error is near surface winds around complex terrain then you can also look into WindNinja from the National Forrest Service.

items.name: StageX
items.source_story_title: The Nixpkgs core team has disbanded
items.summary: A deterministic, container-native system for source-bootstrapped software builds.
items.why_included: It was directly proposed as a deterministic alternative to Nix.
items.evidence: The maintainer-level recommendation specifies its supply-chain and portability properties.

evidence_sources.author: lrvick
evidence_sources.excerpt: Anyone looking for a full source bootstrapped, multi-party-signed, container native, and deterministic alternative to nix, check out https://stagex.tools

items.name: SuperDuper!
items.summary: A long-lived macOS backup utility focused on straightforward disk cloning.
items.why_included: A two-decade user praised its reliability, restraint, and upgrade value.
items.evidence: The first-hand account says the app works, stays lean, and has avoided ads and bloat.

evidence_sources.author: jwr
evidence_sources.excerpt: I have been using SuperDuper for the last 20 years. It works. It does its job. It doesn't pester me with popups.

items.name: z386
items.source_story_title: ao486: x86-compatible Verilog core implementing all features of a 486 SX (2014)
items.summary: An actively developed MiSTer FPGA core recreating an Intel 80386-compatible CPU.
items.why_included: A retro-computing commenter identified it as the more active current project.
items.evidence: The commenter describes z386 as where current development momentum is.

evidence_sources.author: nizmow
evidence_sources.excerpt: z386 is where the action is right now

items.name: News Feed Eradicator
items.summary: A browser extension that removes distracting feeds across major social platforms.
items.why_included: A first-hand user called it wonderful and life-changing across several sites.
items.evidence: The user recommends it for Instagram, Facebook, Reddit, and Hacker News feeds.

evidence_sources.author: nippoo
evidence_sources.excerpt: I use News Feed Eradicator (works for Instagram, Facebook, Reddit, HN etc etc) it's wonderful and has changed my life!

items.name: Cirrux
items.summary: A Dutch-hosted email option for people seeking EU-based service.
items.why_included: A user reported being very happy with its Dutch, EU-hosted setup.
items.evidence: The recommendation is a direct first-hand endorsement in an email-sovereignty discussion.

evidence_sources.author: Marciplan
evidence_sources.excerpt: using cirrux.me and very happy with an actual EU hosted option (Team is Dutch)
